project.name: jawelte (jaxrs-module aggregator)
project.description: Embedded Jakarta REST 4.0 SeBootstrap container for testing REST endpoints inside the per-test-class CDI SE container. jaxrs-module/api ships the @EnableJaxRs annotation, the TestUrl injection point (Supplier<String> returning the live base URL), and ResponseDiff (a thin adapter bridging jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response to TICKET-008's ContentDiff JsonBuilder / XmlBuilder); jaxrs-module/impl ships the JaxRsLifecycleAdapter (@Priority(75) TestModuleLifecyclePort), the TestUrlHolder bean (carrying the impl-internal @JaxRsManaged marker), TestUrlScopeRemap (a core/api BeanScopeMapper provider that upgrades only TestUrlHolder to @TestClassScoped when scope-module is on the classpath, reflectively via MP Config — @ApplicationScoped otherwise), and the CdiIntegrationFilter (per-HTTP-request @RequestScoped activator/deactivator via RequestContextController). The @SessionScoped→@TestMethodScoped remap is provided by scope-module, not this module. Provider selection is Maven-profile-driven (-Pcxf default, -Presteasy switch) mirroring the existing -Powb / -Pweld pattern; no runtime system property is consulted.
